title: Recorded project activity
responsibility: Loads and displays the activity captured when a repository history was built.

inputs.name: HarnessActivity.client
inputs.description: Required history client whose activity operation supplies the stored snapshot.

inputs.name: HarnessActivity.base
inputs.description: Required base passed to activity commit links.

outputs.name: HarnessActivity
outputs.description: Loading message, recorded activity with as-of commit and explicit nonlive notice, or missing-record/rebuild guidance when reading fails. Never calls recorded activity live.
